data.short_meaning: The guide to the right path
data.long_meaning: Elhamun is derived from the Arabic word ‘al-hām’ which means 'to show a path' or 'to guide'. This name signifies being a guide to the right path for others and oneself. The name Elhamun carries the meaning “The guide to the right path” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Elhamun usually hope their child will grow to embody the guide to the right path and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Elhamun total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

The name ultimately serves as a reminder for the individual to stay on the straight path of Islam and to help others do the same.
